snippet.title: Star Fox – Nintendo Direct 6.9.2026
snippet.description:
Star Fox launches for Nintendo Switch 2 on June 25, 2026! Pre-order and download a demo of the game today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/star-fox-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

A battle for the fate of the galaxy begins! Blast off for adventure across the Lylat System with Fox McCloud and his crew in a free demo that includes a tutorial and one of the game's opening stages.

#StarFox #NintendoDirect #NintendoSwitch2

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
